narrative.northStar: Aspen's editorial grid, adapted to SAE
narrative.overview: Oversized Manrope lettering, carbon-black and oxblood planes, gold identity accents, and thin continuous dividers follow the user-selected Aspen reference. Cropped supplied SAE monograms anchor the identity.
keyCharacteristics: Large tightly spaced typography and compact labels
Scroll-linked monograms with static and reduced-motion fallbacks

rules.name: The Paired Surface Rule
rules.body: Pair oxblood with on-oxblood, gold with on-gold, and dark with on-dark rather than the current page foreground.

dos: Do preserve Manrope, divided grids, and supplied identity artwork.
Do preserve keyboard, native details/dialog behavior, themes, and reduced motion.
donts: Do not add rounded card stacks, gradients, or decorative shadows.
Do not use fictional photography or achievements as visual proof.
